notes: Mortgage and housing updates from primary public sources.

items.title: Redfin reports seller concessions in 44.7% of August U.S. home sales
items.title_zh: Redfin：8 月美国 44.7% 的房屋成交含卖方让利
items.summary: Redfin reported that sellers made concessions in 44.7% of August U.S. home sales, up from 42.6% a year earlier. Its analysis defines concessions as seller help with buyer costs, such as repairs, closing costs or mortgage-rate buydowns; it does not include price reductions.
items.summary_zh: Redfin 报告称，8 月美国房屋成交中有 44.7% 包含卖方让利，高于一年前的 42.6%。该分析将让利定义为卖方帮助承担维修、过户成本或房贷利率买断等购房成本，不包括直接降价。

items.title: Redfin reports U.S. pending home sales fell 3.5% week over week
items.title_zh: Redfin：美国待成交房屋销售环比下降 3.5%
items.summary: For the four weeks ending September 13, Redfin reported seasonally adjusted pending sales of 299,126, down 3.5% from the prior week and 5.4% year over year. Redfin said its national metrics cover more than 900 U.S. metro areas and are subject to revision.
items.summary_zh: 截至 9 月 13 日的四周，Redfin 报告的季调待成交房屋销售为 299,126 套，较前一周下降 3.5%、同比下降 5.4%。Redfin 表示其全国指标覆盖 900 多个美国都会区，数据可能修订。

items.title: The average 30-year fixed mortgage rate was 6.95%
items.title_zh: 30 年固定房贷全国平均利率为 6.95%
items.summary: Freddie Mac's PMMS reported a 6.95% average, up from 6.76% the week before. The 15-year fixed average was 6.26%.
items.summary_zh: Freddie Mac 的 PMMS 显示，30 年固定房贷平均利率为 6.95%，高于前一周的 6.76%；15 年固定房贷平均利率为 6.26%。

items.title: August new residential construction: housing starts at a 1.275 million annual rate
items.title_zh: 美国 8 月住宅开工季调年率为 127.5 万套
items.summary: The Census Bureau and HUD reported that August housing starts were at a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 1.275 million, down 2.6% from the revised July estimate and down 1.2% from August 2025. Single-family starts rose 7.6% month over month to a 918,000 annual rate.
items.summary_zh: 美国人口普查局与 HUD 报告称，8 月私人住宅开工的季调年率为 127.5 万套，较修正后的 7 月下降 2.6%，较 2025 年 8 月下降 1.2%；其中独栋住宅开工季调年率为 91.8 万套，环比上升 7.6%。

items.title: Mortgage applications decrease in latest MBA weekly survey
items.title_zh: MBA：最新周度调查显示抵押贷款申请下降
items.summary: MBA reported that total mortgage applications fell 4.1% on a seasonally adjusted basis for the week ending September 11. Its survey’s average 30-year conforming contract rate rose to 6.97%; this is a survey average, not an individual lender quote.
items.summary_zh: MBA 表示，截至 9 月 11 日当周的抵押贷款申请总量经季调后下降 4.1%。其调查中的 30 年期合规贷款平均合同利率升至 6.97%；这是调查平均值，并非个人可获得的贷款报价。

items.title: August new-home purchase mortgage applications decreased 5.5 percent
items.title_zh: MBA：8 月新建房购房抵押贷款申请同比下降 5.5%
items.summary: MBA’s Builder Application Survey reported that August applications for new-home purchases fell 5.5% year over year and 6% from July, before seasonal adjustment. MBA estimated new single-family home sales at a 664,000 seasonally adjusted annual rate; that is an MBA estimate, not the Census Bureau’s official release.
items.summary_zh: MBA 的建商申请调查显示，8 月新建房购房抵押贷款申请同比下降 5.5%、较 7 月下降 6%（未季调）。MBA 估算新建独栋房销售的季调年率为 66.4 万套；这是基于其调查的估算，不是美国人口普查局的官方发布。

items.title: Fannie Mae publishes September 2026 Economic and Housing Outlook
items.title_zh: 房利美发布 2026 年 9 月经济与住房展望
items.summary: Fannie Mae’s Economic and Strategic Research Group published its monthly economic and housing outlook, covering current conditions and forecasts for measures including rates, home sales, prices, starts and mortgage originations. The outlook is a forecast, not a lender quote or guarantee.
items.summary_zh: 房利美经济与战略研究组发布月度经济与住房展望，涵盖利率、房屋销售、房价、开工和房贷发放等指标的现状与预测。该展望属于预测，并非贷款机构报价或保证。

items.title: HUD takes action to make housing more affordable
items.title_zh: HUD 调整公平住房法相关指引，称将降低住房建设成本
items.summary: HUD rescinded prior guidance on the Fair Housing Act statute of limitations for design and construction claims. The agency said the change is intended to reduce unnecessary liability and costs passed on to homebuyers and renters.
items.summary_zh: HUD 撤销了关于《公平住房法》设计和施工索赔诉讼时效的既有指引。该机构表示，此举旨在减少不必要的责任与可能转嫁给购房者和租房者的成本。
